decisions.reason: The supplement range builds on the firm's established pharmacy channel and has its own web page, so it appears to meet aspirations, and the firm's expansion gives enough slack to keep it without search.
The skin and hair supplement was actively promoted as new in pharmacies and fits the growing consumer health strategy, with no sign of a shortfall that would trigger a drop.
The joint health product extends the established Trivital brand in a stable pharmacy segment, so continuing it costs little and the firm's slack allows time for results.
The mushroom-based immune supplement gets only minor web presence and serves a niche with uncertain demand, but low costs and organisational slack favour giving it more time.

The 2018 valsartan contamination recall is a clear shortfall that triggers problemistic search, but switching to another active-ingredient supplier is a likely fix in the generics business, so the firm probably keeps the product on the market.
